component.name: ForskScope
component.summary: Compare and merge files and folders, locally

description.p: ForskScope is a local-first diff and merge tool. It opens two files side by side, highlights every changed line, and lets you apply changes from one side to the other one at a time. It also compares two folders, recursively, through a two-pane Explorer.
Everything runs on your own computer, and nothing is sent anywhere unless you ask: no account, no upload, no telemetry.

It also works with AI agents, and leaves the decisions to you. Through its "compare" and "mcp" commands, an agent can compare files and folders and open the ForskScope window on what it found, but it cannot change a file. You review and merge.
ForskScope works as a Git difftool and mergetool. Every change is marked by a sign as well as a colour, a red–green safe palette is available, and the interface is in English and Japanese.

description.p: A System theme and a High contrast option, words beside the toolbar's symbols, and selectable rows in folder comparisons.
A text size setting from 100 % to 200 %, stronger contrast in every theme, and no text smaller than 12 px.
Spreadsheet comparison uses an updated archive library, which fixes four security advisories. ForskScope was never affected by them.
The description says that ForskScope works with AI agents and leaves the decisions to you.
An app icon, and folders a screen reader can open and close.
One program: the app, and its commands for scripts and AI agents.
Reports you can hand to someone.
The documentation says what the app does, and replaced lines stay distinct.
Colours for red-green colour blindness, and one bar at the top.
